risk_if_not_implemented: Without Automated Employment Status Notifications, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Account Management
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to:
(1) Define authorized system account types;
(2) Define prohibited system account types; and
(3) Proactively govern individual, group, system, service, application, guest and temporary accounts.
compensating_control_1.justification: Account Management (IAC-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Automated Employment Status Notifications (HRS-12.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Personnel Termination
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to govern the termination of individual employment.
compensating_control_2.justification: Personnel Termination (HRS-12) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Automated Employment Status Notifications (HRS-12.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
